GET /api/v2/group
This endpoint is used to view [User Groups](https://docs.clickup.com/en/articles/4010016-teams-how-to-create-user-groups) in your Workspace.\ \ In our API documentation, `team_id` refers to the ID of a Workspace, and `group_id` refers to the ID of a User Group.
Required: team_id (query) — Workspace ID. **Note**: For this endpoint, `team_id`` is a required query parameter.
Optional: group_ids (query) — Enter one or more User Group IDs to retrieve information about specific User Group(s).\ \ For example: \ \ `?team_id=12456&group_ids=ABC12345&group_ids=DEF98765`
